This is the DT-1601 classification of the complete PostgreSQL 18.4 `pg_type` oracle inventory.
It distinguishes application types from derived arrays, pseudo-types, system relation composites,
and internal index/catalog representations.

## Approved Internal Exclusions

| Type | Rationale |
| --- | --- |
| `aclitem` | PostgreSQL's internal ACL storage value has no binary send/receive contract and is not a general-purpose application column type; BicDB exposes ACLs through catalog-compatible privilege surfaces instead. |
| `gtsvector` | PostgreSQL uses gtsvector as an internal GiST signature representation for text-search indexes; applications store tsvector and tsquery instead. |
| `pg_brin_bloom_summary` | PostgreSQL uses this type only as an internal BRIN bloom index summary and does not expose it as a general-purpose data contract. |
| `pg_brin_minmax_multi_summary` | PostgreSQL uses this type only as an internal BRIN minmax-multi index summary and does not expose it as a general-purpose data contract. |
